'''2008 Worlds Team Peter Fratjord DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Peter Fratjord]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet spelling Fratjord kept as written. Knowledge And Defense listed above objective on sheet. Abbreviations expanded best-effort.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Peter Fratjord]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
